premises.text: Businesses use custom currency (gift cards, promo codes, refund credits) in marketing but payment systems make enabling it hard
premises.evidence_span: enabling custom currency is actually really hard to do. It's complicated and payment systems aren't set up to do it well

premises.text: Merchants running their own online checkout are stuck building custom currency solutions themselves
premises.evidence_span: if you're one of the 300,000 businesses that run their own online checkout, you're stuck building your own custom currency solution yourself

premises.text: GiftBit SaaS provides a web app and API for businesses to have, distribute, and manage their own custom currency
premises.evidence_span: We have built a web application and a powerful API to enable a business to have, distribute, and manage their own custom currency

premises.text: Simple API checkout integration plus marketing tools to control, send, and track currency make it usable by developers and marketers
premises.evidence_span: GIFBit integrates easily with a merchant's checkout through a simple API integration. It's very easy for developers

premises.text: Platform supports creating promotional codes with amount, window, and volume, and can remind/incentivize recipients to spend unused gift value
premises.evidence_span: using GiftBit, Socks in the Box is actually able to incentivize Rita to come back to their site and spend that money

premises.text: Pricing starts at $90/month for 1,000 active codes to be accessible to businesses of any size
premises.evidence_span: We've priced our product starting at $90 a month to make it accessible to businesses of any size

domains.name: Hard custom-currency problem for online merchants

value.text: Let online businesses enable flexible custom currency without building it themselves so they can drive sales
value.evidence_span: no one needs to build their own complicated custom currency because they have GiftBit

causal_links.evidence_span: you're stuck building your own custom currency solution yourself, until now
GiftBit has built a software as a service platform to solve this problem
make it accessible to businesses of any size

notes: Prior gift-card reselling and named brand campaigns treated as experience framing/traction, not premises. Shopify/Stripe integrations are roadmap features folded into platform availability, not separate premises (§4.1(5)). Need/product/pricing triad justified.
